engine_name: Production Result Validation & Asset Promotion Director
purpose: Validate provider-generated production results against the immutable CSD-030 master and CSD-031 execution evidence, classify defects, and promote only accepted results into the CSD-028 master continuity registry.
core_principle: A generated result is not a production asset until it proves lineage, contract fidelity, identity continuity, technical integrity and cinematic validity.

decision_policy.PROMOTE: All hard gates pass and no blocking defect exists.
decision_policy.PROMOTION_PENDING: Validation passes but registry approval or required human review is outstanding.
decision_policy.QUARANTINE: Lineage, identity, integrity or canonical-state uncertainty prevents safe use.
decision_policy.REJECT: Hard validation failure or cinematic defect makes the result unsuitable for the contracted frame.

hard_gates: Result must map to exactly one logical job and execution attempt.
Provider job identity and result provenance must be verifiable.
CSD-030 master revision and fingerprint must match the execution contract.
Result must not claim a superseded or rejected input asset as current master.
Character identity must remain within the locked identity tolerance.
Costume, props, environment and spatial continuity must remain contract-compliant.
Frame perspective, camera intent and blocking must remain within the approved production contract.
Negative constraints must not be violated.
No future-state or cross-scene information leakage may be introduced.
Promotion cannot occur before QA acceptance.
Promotion must create an immutable asset version with complete lineage.
